e8b_core_resource_projection.design: strict deterministic BF16 training; fixed 22 epochs for B2/B3, no early stopping, epoch-22 canonical; B1 under the stored section-7.3 recipe (15/22 expected, 100-epoch stress); full FP32 canonical evaluation; G14-FP32 on the LM arms; final R1/R2/R3 readouts and interventions; measured checkpoint footprint
e8b_core_resource_projection.inputs_note: NOT every entry below is measured. Keys ending ASSUMED or UNSOURCED are not measurements; the container name is retained for continuity with earlier records.

measured_inputs.amended_design_cost_note: the 78.0 versus 53.88 s/epoch difference is the TOTAL cost of the amended execution design relative to the superseded one; it bundles three simultaneous changes (strict-deterministic math SDPA backend, the fp32 frozen-model instance, and enforcement assertions) and is not attributed to any single one

selection_sensitivity_study.status: VOID under the fixed-22 epoch-22-canonical rule: the study's object (sensitivity to max-over-epochs checkpoint selection across retained search checkpoints) no longer exists. Not costed. Reinstating any analogue requires a fresh user decision and a fresh projection.

pretrained_identity_35h.includes: the COMPLETE planned pretrained-identity programme: A1 baseline, A4, A7c, all six B3 core cells, B3's final R2/R3 readouts and interventions, and every already-spent search, characterisation, validation and probe hour that loaded the pretrained checkpoint
pretrained_identity_35h.retry_allowance: NONE. The plan tolerates zero B3 retries; any retry or any additional B3-loading evaluation triggers a stop-and-ask BEFORE execution

e8b_remaining_vs_180h_core.scope_note: E8B cells and E8B evaluation only; the programme-wide 180 h ceiling also covers the remaining E8A arms (about 17.6-21.6 h expected per section 13.2), which leaves the combined expectation far below the ceiling

storage.status: UNRESOLVED allocation (E8A precedent: free space is not a quota). The free-space check passes and is reported as context, not as a discharged allocation gate.

train_250k_step_scaling.basis: step-scaled from the MEASURED 40k rate; no 250k E8B cell has ever run
train_250k_step_scaling.break_even: the pretrained identity reaches 35 h if the per-CELL 250k cost rises about 12 per cent (4.70 h per cell instead of 4.189 h). Because each cell also carries a fixed G14 and gate overhead, the break-even on the TRAINING RATE alone is higher, about 17 per cent.

r2_r3_per_row.basis: UNSOURCED. Neither rate is measured for E8B, and the previously claimed E7b provenance was FALSE: the E7b S8_projection figure is 0.0291 MILLISECONDS for a LayerNorm-plus-Linear stage, a different operation in units 1000x apart. No replacement provenance was invented.
r2_r3_per_row.sensitivity: if R2 and R3 each cost 3x the assumed rate, the six pretrained cells cost 2.428 h more and the headroom is exhausted
r2_r3_per_row.status: OPEN RISK: close it with a measurement or accept it explicitly before core execution

g14_row_cost.basis: pooled measurement 5.139 s/row plus a 3 per cent conservative margin

a4_a7c_unrun.basis: expected-epoch projections; neither arm has run. Their recipes carry max_epochs 100 and patience 10, so the configured-cap cost is 8.469 h EACH (protocol 13.2). The one arm of this family that has run, A1, came in 23 per cent BELOW its projection.

efficiency_s19.basis: protocol 13.2 range 0.500-1.000 h, charged at the upper bound
